title: KumbhDoot: A Scale-Ready, LLM-Bounded Architecture for Mass-Gathering Public-Service Assistants
abstract: arXiv:2608.07520v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Mass religious gatherings such as the Kumbh Mela concentrate tens of millions of people into a single region over a few weeks, producing intense, repetitive, multilingual, and safety-critical demand for information. The default response, a conversational assistant that routes every query to a large language model (LLM), is poorly matched to this setting: it is costly at scale, slow on emergency paths, prone to hallucination on facts that can cause physical harm, and unusable when connectivity fails. translated_title: KumbhDoot：一种面向大规模人群聚集公共服务助手的可扩展、LLM受限架构
translated_abstract: 大昆梅拉（Kumbh Mela）等大型宗教集会在数周内将数千万人聚集到同一区域，产生了高强度、重复性、多语言且关乎人身安全的信息服务需求。默认的应对方案——将每个查询都路由到大语言模型（LLM）的对话式助手——与这种场景并不匹配：它在规模化使用时成本高昂，在紧急请求路径上响应缓慢，容易在可能导致人身伤害的事实性问题上产生幻觉，并且在网络连接中断时完全无法使用。我们介绍了 KumbhDoot，一个为纳西克 Simhastha 大昆梅拉构建的智能体式朝圣者助手，它建立在一种截然不同的原则之上。其基础设计原则是优先采用语义相似度匹配，而非一开始就调用 LLM。只有当基于相似度的检索不足以产生正确答案时，才会调用生成式模型。该系统利用一种“语义缓存”（semantic cache），即以嵌入向量索引的存储，作为单一的……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 针对大昆梅拉等数千万级人群聚集场景，KumbhDoot 提出“语义缓存优先、LLM 兜底”的架构，仅在语义检索无法给出正确答案时才调用大语言模型，从而实现低成本、低延迟、抗幻觉且网络中断下仍可靠的安全关键公共服务助手。
en_tdlr: KumbhDoot is a scale-ready pilgrim assistant for mass religious gatherings that prioritizes embedding-based semantic retrieval over LLM invocation—calling generative models only when retrieval fails—achieving lower cost, lower latency, reduced hallucination risk, and safety-critical reliability for public-service information at massive scale.
